name: Lincoln University
description: Lincoln University, near Christchurch, began as a school of agriculture in 1878 and is New Zealand's smallest university. It specialises in agriculture, agribusiness, commerce, environment, land and food.
whyIncluded: Lincoln University is among the 10 universities in New Zealand most chosen by international students (1,430 international students enrolled in 2025, Ministry of Education provider data), per the FinexisEdu shortlist research of October 2026.
